$comment: The curated Icon set: Lucide's canonical kebab names, in the order the spec's glyph table lists them. `npm run icons:build` compiles each into src/icons/generated/ and the Figma builder; `npm run icons:check` (in verify) fails if the committed output differs. `lucide` is the version the glyphs were reviewed against and must equal the installed devDependency. Adding a name is a spec change first (guidelines/components/icon.md, Glyphs), then this file, then the build.

figma.$comment: The Figma Icon set is published, so a glyph added after its first publish cannot come from the builder: the builder makes the first `published` glyphs of `icons` (a published set is never rebuilt, or every instance would detach), and each later batch is an extension, scripts/figma/components/icon.<id>.extend.figma.js, which `npm run icons:build` generates and `--extend` runs against the file. Create mode runs the builder and then every extension, so a fresh build has all the glyphs, in list order. A new glyph goes at the end of `icons` and into a new batch here; icons:build fails if a glyph is in neither.
